role: District Representative · Pasay City, Lone District
summary: Pasay City representative with 10 principal-authored bills. Authored housing-loan restructuring and condonation, an electricity lifeline-rate expansion and travel-tax abolition; co-authored estate tax amnesty, crisis assistance and the national minimum wage.
caveat: Small portfolio and several co-authored items; no non-economic evidence found. No votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored housing-loan condonation (-2) and electricity lifeline expansion (-2); co-authored minimum wage and crisis assistance (-2 each); authored travel-tax abolition and co-authored estate tax amnesty (+2).
